Slipstream Quirk.name: Slipstream Quirk
Slipstream Quirk.description:
🌪️ Your legs burst with speed and the wind runs with you: a tailwind of your own that keeps you fast.

🧬 A Fusion Quirk of Speed Boost and Wind: each side at about half a single Quirk's reach, plus moves only the fusion can do.
🌱 At the start you blink across a short street and knock a foe off balance with the wind of your passing.
📈 With training: wall runs and gap jumps on a riding gust, carrying someone out of danger in a pocket of still air, a blinding vortex around a foe, a wake that pulls smoke out of a corridor, and a cyclone-wrapped flying kick.
⚠️ Tight indoor turns, heavy rain and slick floors cut your speed.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Stamina Drain, as bursting and steering wind together burns energy fast.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Tenya Iida (Engine), Inasa Yoarashi (Whirlwind).

📈 Grants: Speed +1, Quirk Mobility +10, Quirk Control +10, Evacuation +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Tailwind Burst, Passing Gust
Slipstream Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: bursts of speed through the legs with a self-made tailwind wrapped around the body. New adult user: blinks across a short street, keeps a sprint's pace through a long run on the tailwind, and the wind of their passing shoves an adult off balance. More needs techniques. Limits: tight indoor turns, heavy rain, slick floors and strong headwinds cut the speed; no flight, air blades or storm-scale wind yet. Quirk Strain: light: burst, passing gust; moderate: wall run, sheltered carry, vortex circle; heavy: smoke-clearing wake, cyclone kick; severe: signature jet-stream evacuation or a moving storm wall. Fusion: Speed Boost plus Wind, each about half single-nature range and force; no engine-level top speed or district-wide winds; only it rides its own tailwind and drags a pulling wake behind it. Type: Emitter and Transformation. Law: unlicensed public speeding or gusts are a Quirk offense; a knocked-down pedestrian is assault. Look: streaming hair, a whistling wake.
